payload.comment:
Preprocessing stage is internally consistent and well-executed. All deterministic checks pass: PathMNIST 9-class 28×28×3 RGB loaded at full official split sizes (89996/10004/7180), archive hashes verified, no blank images, no duplicates, modest imbalance (1.63×), and train/val class proportions are nearly identical. The representation plan (z-score normalization from train stats, 6 built-in augmentations yielding factor 7 → 629972 augmented samples) is sound and correctly scoped. The extension gate properly tracks two pending proposals; hflip is a built-in primitive requiring no approval, and the compact conv-token transformer remains pending without invalidating existing primitives. No deterministic findings are present, so no stop condition is met.

Warnings (non-blocking, carry forward):
1. llm_model_digest is null across ingestion, profiling, and the run manifest despite llm_model='qwen3.8' being specified. This is a reproducibility gap for any LLM-in-the-loop decisions; populate the digest before training/evaluation stages.
2. Prior-art traceability: three ideas (augmentation_regularization, ghostnet_vgg_robustness, temperature_scaling_calibration) draw inferences slightly beyond the quoted scope of their cited papers. Per protocol, a cited quote establishes traceability, not support for every inference; these remain hypotheses-to-validate and do not block the pipeline, but the downstream experiment design should treat them as unconfirmed.
3. The test set (CRC-VAL-HE-7K) originates from a different clinical center. This is acknowledged in the manifest and split manifest (official_test_separate_center=true). The OOD aggregate (arithmetic mean of per-severity AUROCs) should be interpreted with this domain shift in mind; ensure the evaluation protocol explicitly labels this as cross-center OOD rather than in-distribution.

No critical or blocking issues identified. Proceed to the next stage.
llm_issues: llm_model_digest is null despite llm_model='qwen3.8' specified; populate before training/evaluation stages for full reproducibility of LLM-in-the-loop decisions

Prior-art traceability: augmentation_regularization, ghostnet_vgg_robustness, and temperature_scaling_calibration ideas infer beyond the quoted scope of their cited papers; treat as unconfirmed hypotheses
Test set (CRC-VAL-HE-7K) is from a different clinical center; OOD AUROC aggregates must be interpreted as cross-center domain shift, not in-distribution performance
